feeds.title: British Liver Trust News
feeds.description: British Liver Trust works towards a world without liver disease. They are UK's leading liver health charity working to improve liver health for all and supporting those affected by liver disease or cancer. We spread awareness of the risk factors of liver disease and provide vital advice to help people improve their liver health. We provide patients with up-to-date information and support including a free nurse-led helpline and online community.

feeds.title: ILCA Online News
feeds.description: ILCA Online aspires towards advancing research in the pathogenesis, prevention, and treatment of liver cancer by promoting novel pathogenic, diagnostic, and therapeutic interventions for liver cancer by taking a transversal approach to research and bringing together scientists, physicians, and allied professionals from all interrelated fields.

feeds.title: News Medical » Liver Cancer
feeds.description: We aim to share medical and scientific breakthroughs with the widest possible audience of potential beneficiaries worldwide and provide a forum for ideas, debate, and learning, and facilitate interaction between all parts of the medical health sciences community worldwide. Read our 'Liver Cancer' section to get in-depth knowledge about news and research in the field.

feeds.title: Chennai Liver Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Chennai Liver Foundation Blog promotes awareness about liver health for more than two decades. They are a voluntary, non-profit organization that aims to promote awareness about liver health by supporting research and educational activities. With their blog, they intend to help promote further research, provide education about liver wellness, and work to find cures and better treatments for all kinds of liver ailments.

feeds.title: Nature » Liver Cancer
feeds.description: Nature is a weekly international journal publishing the finest peer-reviewed research in all fields of science and technology on the basis of its originality, timeliness, accessibility, elegance, and surprising conclusions. Through our 'Liver Cancer' section, we aim to promote awareness about the malignant tumor that grows on the surface or inside the liver that causes cancer.

feeds.title: Cancer Commons News » Liver Cancer
feeds.description: Cancer Commons is a nonprofit that provides personalized action plans to metastatic cancer patients while learning from every patient to help others urgently seeking answers. Follow their blog that has a dedicated section for liver cancer and read all important articles related to liver cancer and its treatments.
